title: Morphy
description: Morphy a Morph mod Transform into mobs and blocks inside Minecraft. Become mobs or blocks and truly become one of them. Compatible with modded entities and content.
body:
#  Morphy — Transform into Mobs and Blocks in Minecraft

Become almost any mob or block in Minecraft with a simple and intuitive morph system.
Become mobs with synchronized models, size and hitboxes.

##  Morph Menu

Browse and search all available morphs through an in-game GUI with live previews.

### Controls

M → Open Morph Menu

---

##  Commands

/ morph menu  
/ morph menu mobs  
/ morph menu blocks  

/ morph set <mob_or_block>  
/ morph set <mob_or_block> [targets]  

/ morph clear  
/ morph clear [targets]  

/ morph normal

---

##  Target Selectors

@a → All players  
player → Specific player  
team <name> → Specific team

---

##  Permissions

Server commands require OP permissions.

Singleplayer works normally with cheats enabled.
